class.name: OcgMessagePrinterostream
class.brief_description: Implementation of a message printer associated with an std::ostream The std::ostream may be either externally defined one (e.g. std::cout), or file stream maintained internally (depending on constructor).
class.description: ! Implementation of a message printer associated with an std::ostream ! The std::ostream may be either externally defined one (e.g. std::cout), ! or file stream maintained internally (depending on constructor).

method.name: from_2
method.description: Create printer for output to a specified file. The option theDoAppend specifies whether file should be appended or rewritten. For specific file names (cout, cerr) standard streams are used

method.name: Close
method.description: Flushes the output stream and destroys it if it has been specified externally with option doFree (or if it is internal file stream)

method.name: ToColorize
method.description: Returns TRUE if text output into console should be colorized depending on message gravity; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetToColorize
method.description: Set if text output into console should be colorized depending on message gravity.
